shared_style: Production-ready 2D pixel art for a fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark fantasy dungeon game. Match the supplied Overbless pixel-art references: crisp hard pixel clusters, readable silhouette at 128 pixels, dark navy outlines, restrained cyan/purple/orange accents, no antialiasing, no blur, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff background around every isolated object.

prompts.golem_idle_south: Create one isolated shockwave golem idle key pose facing south toward the camera. Massive broad stone-and-iron body, about 1.35 times the Dasher height and visibly heavier, squat legs, huge forearms designed to slam the floor, cracked rune core glowing muted amber, dark gray stone with restrained rust-red armor. Neutral standing pose, both feet visible, hands lowered, centered, full body, generous empty magenta border.

Preserve body proportions, rune core placement logic, stone cracks, armor colors and lighting. Back silhouette and both feet visible, neutral standing pose, centered, full body, generous empty magenta border.

prompts.echo_vfx_sheet: Create a strict 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet with eight separate isolated Echo blessing assets, one asset centered in each equal cell with wide magenta gutters. Top row left to right: 1) Echo HUD seal icon, angular double-chevron rune; 2) tiny enemy overhead Echo status icon; 3) translucent-looking doubled humanoid silhouette mask rendered as solid purple pixel clusters; 4) delayed straight attack telegraph with two parallel edges and a small repeat notch. Bottom row left to right: 5) delayed circular shockwave telegraph with double ring; 6) Echo application burst, mirrored rune fragments around an empty center; 7) overblessed resonance aura ring with three outward spikes; 8) resonance arrival floor sigil. Purple and pale violet only with dark navy outlines. Every cell must contain exactly one asset, no text, no borders, no labels.
prompts.environment_mechanics_sheet: Create a strict 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet with twelve separate isolated dungeon mechanic assets, one centered in each equal cell with wide magenta gutters. Three-quarter top-down pixel art matching the reference dungeon. Row 1: 1) seamless cliff-edge floor tile with a clear safe stone lip and black-blue void below; 2) cliff inner-corner tile; 3) cracked destructible stone pillar intact with bright readable fissures; 4) same pillar heavily damaged. Row 2: 5) destroyed pillar rubble pile; 6) spike trap inactive and flush with floor; 7) same spike trap warning with partially raised spikes and amber rune; 8) same spike trap active with fully raised spikes. Row 3: 9) broken wall rubble; 10) fractured dungeon floor tile; 11) final-room dark stone floor tile with restrained purple inlay; 12) open exit pedestal with cyan-gold core. Keep collision silhouettes unambiguous. Every cell exactly one asset, no text, no borders, no labels.
